description:
Bring home a stunning collection of mid-century American art pottery with this 4-piece vintage Hull Art Pottery “Wildflower” lot, accompanied by two collector reference books by Sharon Loraine Felker. Known for its delicate matte pastel glazes and raised floral motifs, this collection showcases the iconic craftsmanship of Hull Pottery from Crooksville, Ohio.
Lot Details & Measurements:
* Large Double-Handled Fan Vase: 11” tall. Marked on base: “Hull Art, USA, W-15-10.” Features a beautiful yellow-to-pink pastel ombr finish with molded floral details.
* Ewer/Pitcher Vase: 6.5” tall. Marked on base: “Hull, W6-6, U.S.A.” Features a bulbous body, twisted vine-style handle, and pink-and-green floral design.
* Double-Handled Urn Vase: 6.5” tall. Marked on base: “HULL, U.S.A., W-10-6” or similar Wildflower numbering. Features a soft pink upper section blending into a blue base with embossed floral accents. Similar in mold style to the Wildflower line.
* Small Double-Handled Vase: 4.75” tall. Marked on base: “HULL, U.S.A., 405-4 3/4”. Features a fluted rim, yellow-to-blue gradient, and raised yellow floral accent.
Reference Books Included:
* Lovely Hull Pottery by Sharon L. Felker spiral-bound.
* Lovely Hull Pottery Book 2 by Sharon Loraine Felker.
Condition: Pottery is in pre-owned vintage condition with vibrant colors and attractive display quality. Expect normal light wear consistent with age, along with minor manufacturing variations typical of vintage art pottery. Please review all photos for detailed views of each piece and its respective hallmarks. Books are in good collector condition with light shelf wear.
A fantastic instant collection for both novice decorators and seasoned Hull pottery enthusiasts!

description:
Product Overview:
This listing includes a set of polished mineral specimens featuring Ruby in Zoisite, Ruby Fuchsite, and Ruby in Matrix. Each specimen has distinct coloration and patterning with polished surfaces.

Specifications:
- Ruby in Zoisite: Dark green and black matrix with pink-red ruby inclusions.
- Ruby Fuchsite: Bright pink to magenta hues with white and dark mineral inclusions, cut in a triangular shape.
- Ruby in Matrix: Rougher texture with ruby crystals embedded in white and gray host rock.
- All specimens are tumbled and polished.
- Approximate largest specimen size: 1.5 inches.

Tobacco Pipe Lot - 3 Pieces
Royal Duke of Dundee, London Made, Mixed Brands
Vintage before 2006
A diverse collection of vintage tobacco pipes featuring classic wood construction and unique decorative finishes. This lot includes recognizable names in pipe manufacturing, offering a range of shapes and aesthetics for the collector or enthusiast. These pieces represent traditional smoking craftsmanship and mid-century design styles.
Items Included:
Royal Duke of Dundee wood pipe with a straight stem and traditional grain pattern
London Made dark wood bent pipe bowl (bowl only, stem is not included)
Bent pipe featuring a unique red metallic sparkle finish with a black stem and silver-tone band

The Royal Duke and red metallic pipes are complete with stems; the London Made piece consists of the bowl only. Surface scuffs, light scratches, and minor oxidation on the stems are present, consistent with age and handled donation status. No significant structural cracks observed. Cleaning is recommended before use.
